summary: Completed backend regression and responsive UI testing for homepage, logo rendering, category tabs, owner login, and portfolio CMS add/edit flows; API cleanup confirmed the temporary test record was removed.
action_items: Optionally resolve the React exhaustive-deps warning for nav in Admin useEffect.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_UI portfolio item through the owner UI; it was edited in UI and removed via authenticated API cleanup after the browser harness stopped before its delete step.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Homepage/logo, mobile and desktop overflow, category selection, Reels/Designs tabs, owner auth, protected admin access, and CMS add/edit were verified. CMS delete was not completed by the browser harness; temporary data was confirmed removed via API. Figma remains sign-in gated, so visual comparison is limited to the implemented render.
rca of the issue: The initial local pytest invocation failed because the test module reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL while the shell did not export frontend/.env; rerunning with that environment value passed. This is a test setup issue, not an application failure. Production build completed with only a missing nav dependency warning in Admin useEffect.
